claim_text: Prof. Moshe Cohen-Eliya said there was 'no precedent in the world' for a court putting a prime minister into incapacity on legal grounds.
notes: Accepted with a narrow False verdict on the categorical worldwide-no-precedent assertion. Thailand's Constitutional Court ended PM Samak Sundaravej's tenure in 2008 after a constitutional violation; Pakistan's Supreme Court disqualified Nawaz Sharif in 2017 and ordered that he cease to be prime minister. Foreign legal mechanisms differ from Israel's incapacity doctrine, so no broader equivalence is asserted. Claim origin is recurring panelist, not Channel 14 editorial speech.
